verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a single-URL HTML API (one API key plus one encoded URL per call), with no batch-submission or asynchronous job endpoint. The usage API's concurrency reporting and the CLI's crawl, export and schedule commands are adjacent features, not documented batch-async scraping of a URL list. Parallelizing calls client-side would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously
